notes: HunyuanImage 2.1 is Tencent's text-to-image diffusion model. Repo layout: dit/ (main + refiner + fp8 + distilled variants), vae/, and dual text encoders (byT5 + Qwen-VL). Onboarding needs (1) new family 'hunyuan_image' that detects model_name from config.json, (2) custom pipeline runner for the (text encoder x2 -> dit -> refiner -> vae) flow, (3) optional fp8 / distilled variants.
